qa.question: What is the swim distance in a full IRONMAN?
qa.answer: A full IRONMAN swim is 3.8 km (2.4 miles).
paraphrases: How far is the swim in a full IRONMAN?
How long is the swimming leg of a full IRONMAN?

qa.question: What is the bike distance in a full IRONMAN?
qa.answer: A full IRONMAN bike leg is 180 km (112 miles).
paraphrases: How far is the cycling leg in a full IRONMAN?
How long is the bike ride in a full IRONMAN?

qa.question: What is the run distance in a full IRONMAN?
qa.answer: A full IRONMAN run is a full marathon: 42.2 km (26.2 miles).
paraphrases: How far is the run in a full IRONMAN?
How long is the running leg of a full IRONMAN?

qa.question: What are the distances of an IRONMAN 70.3?
qa.answer: An IRONMAN 70.3 has a 1.9 km swim, a 90 km bike and a 21.1 km run (70.3 miles in total).
paraphrases: How long is each leg of an IRONMAN 70.3?

qa.question: How do I register for an IRONMAN race?
qa.answer: Create an athlete account on the official IRONMAN website, open the event's page, choose the race and distance, and complete the payment.
paraphrases: How can I sign up for an IRONMAN race?
What is the process to enrol in an IRONMAN event?

qa.question: What is the registration fee for an IRONMAN race?
qa.answer: Entry fees differ by event, distance and registration date. The current price is shown on each event's registration page.
paraphrases: How much does it cost to enter an IRONMAN race?
What is the entry fee for an IRONMAN event?

qa.question: Can I get a refund if I cancel my IRONMAN registration?
qa.answer: Refund rules differ by event and are set in the event's terms. Many events do not refund entries but may allow a transfer or deferral, so check the event's policy.
paraphrases: Will I get my money back if I withdraw from an IRONMAN?
Is a refund possible when I cancel my IRONMAN entry?

qa.question: Can I transfer my IRONMAN entry to another person?
qa.answer: Many events allow transfers up to a set deadline, sometimes for a fee. The rules are on the event's page.
paraphrases: Can I give my IRONMAN slot to someone else?
Is it allowed to hand over my IRONMAN registration to another athlete?

qa.question: Can I defer my IRONMAN entry to next year?
qa.answer: Deferral depends on the event and the reason. Check the event's deferral policy and deadline.
paraphrases: Can I roll my IRONMAN registration over to the following year?
Is it possible to postpone my IRONMAN entry until next year?

qa.question: Is a wetsuit mandatory in the IRONMAN swim?
qa.answer: No, wetsuits are not mandatory. Whether they are allowed depends on the water temperature, and officials confirm it on race morning.
paraphrases: Do I have to wear a wetsuit in the IRONMAN swim?
Are wetsuits compulsory for the IRONMAN swim?

qa.question: Is drafting allowed on the bike?
qa.answer: No. Drafting is not allowed in IRONMAN races. You must keep the required gap behind the rider in front and pass within the allowed time.
paraphrases: Am I allowed to ride in another cyclist's slipstream on the bike?
Is it legal to draft on the bike course?

qa.question: What is the penalty for drafting?
qa.answer: A drafting violation is a time penalty served in a penalty tent. The exact duration is in the event's athlete guide and the competition rules.
paraphrases: What happens if I get caught drafting?
What is the punishment for drafting on the bike?

qa.question: Where do I drop off my bike before the race?
qa.answer: Bikes are racked at bike check-in in the transition area, usually the day before the race. Times and location are in the athlete guide.
paraphrases: Where do I leave my bicycle before race day?
Where is bike check-in?

qa.question: What should I eat during the bike leg?
qa.answer: Practise your nutrition in training, take carbohydrates and fluids at regular intervals, and use the aid stations. Avoid trying new products on race day.
paraphrases: What nutrition should I take on the bike leg?
What should I have to eat while cycling in the race?

qa.question: How many aid stations are on the run course?
qa.answer: The number and spacing of run aid stations vary by event, often every 1.5 to 3 km. The course map in the athlete guide shows them.
paraphrases: How many aid stations are there on the running course?
How many feed zones are on the run?

qa.question: Can spectators watch the swim start?
qa.answer: Usually yes, from the designated spectator areas near the swim start. Follow the event's spectator guide for restricted zones.
paraphrases: Are spectators permitted to see the swim start?
Can supporters watch the start of the swim?

qa.question: How do I qualify for the IRONMAN World Championship in Kona?
qa.answer: You earn a qualifying slot at an IRONMAN race by finishing high enough in your age group. Slots are claimed at the slot allocation after the race, and unclaimed slots roll down.
paraphrases: How can I earn a Kona World Championship slot?
What do I need to do to get into the IRONMAN World Championship in Kona?

qa.question: What is the minimum age to race an IRONMAN?
qa.answer: You must be at least 18 years old on race day to compete in an IRONMAN or IRONMAN 70.3.
paraphrases: How old do I need to be to race an IRONMAN?
What is the youngest age allowed to compete in an IRONMAN?

qa.question: How do I volunteer at an IRONMAN event?
qa.answer: Volunteer sign-up is on the event's page on the official IRONMAN website. Choose a role and shift and register.
paraphrases: How can I sign up to volunteer at an IRONMAN event?
How do I help out as a volunteer at an IRONMAN?

qa.question: Are headphones allowed during the race?
qa.answer: No. Headphones and earbuds are not allowed during the race for safety reasons.
paraphrases: Can I wear headphones during the race?
Is listening to music with earbuds permitted in the race?

qa.question: What water temperature should I expect for the swim?
qa.answer: It depends on the event and the season. The official water temperature is announced during race week and confirmed on race morning.
paraphrases: How warm is the water for the swim?
What temperature will the water be during the swim?

qa.question: What time does the race start?
qa.answer: Start times vary by event and wave. Your start time and wave are listed in the athlete guide.
paraphrases: At what time does the race begin?
What is the start time of the race?

qa.question: Where is the expo and packet pickup?
qa.answer: The expo and athlete check-in are usually at or near the race venue in the days before the race. The location and opening hours are in the athlete guide.
paraphrases: Where can I collect my race pack and visit the expo?
Where do I pick up my race packet?

qa.question: Can I rent a bike for an IRONMAN race?
qa.answer: Many events have local bike rental or bike shipping partners. Check the event's travel and logistics page.
paraphrases: Is it possible to hire a bike for an IRONMAN race?
Can I borrow a bike for an IRONMAN race?

qa.question: How are age groups decided at IRONMAN races?
qa.answer: Athletes are grouped in five-year age groups (for example 25-29, 30-34) based on their age on 31 December of the race year.
paraphrases: How are athletes sorted into age groups at IRONMAN races?
How does IRONMAN decide the age group categories?

qa.question: Is there a relay option at IRONMAN races?
qa.answer: Some events offer relay teams, mainly at IRONMAN 70.3 races. Check whether your event has a relay on its registration page.
paraphrases: Can a team do an IRONMAN race as a relay?
Do IRONMAN races have a relay category?

qa.question: Where can I park near the race start?
qa.answer: Parking and shuttle details are in each event's athlete guide and spectator guide. Parking often fills early, so arrive in good time.
paraphrases: Where is the parking close to the race start?
Where can I leave my car near the start of the race?

qa.question: What equipment is mandatory on race day?
qa.answer: You need a working bike, an approved helmet that is fastened whenever you are on the bike, and your race bib displayed as required. The full list is in the competition rules.
paraphrases: Which gear is compulsory on race day?
What equipment do I need to carry on race day?

qa.question: Where can I find my race results?
qa.answer: Live tracking and final results are published on the official IRONMAN results page for your event, usually within hours of your finish.
paraphrases: Where can I look up my race results?
How do I see my finishing time and results?

qa.question: Where can I find the athlete guide?
qa.answer: The athlete guide is published on the event's page on the official IRONMAN website a few weeks before the race.
paraphrases: Where can I download the athlete guide?
Where is the athlete guide published?

qa.question: When does registration open for an IRONMAN race?
qa.answer: Opening dates differ by event. The registration opening date is shown on each event's page, and many events open registration right after the previous year's race.
paraphrases: When can I start registering for an IRONMAN race?
On what date does the registration window open for an IRONMAN?

qa.question: What is the registration deadline for an IRONMAN race?
qa.answer: Registration stays open until the event sells out or the event's closing date, whichever comes first. The date is shown on the event's registration page.
paraphrases: What is the cutoff date to register for an IRONMAN race?
What is the deadline to sign up for an IRONMAN race?

qa.question: What are the age group awards?
qa.answer: The top finishers in each age group, usually the top three, receive age group awards at the awards ceremony. Check the event's athlete guide for the ceremony time.
paraphrases: What awards are given in the age groups?

qa.question: How hilly is the bike course?
qa.answer: The elevation profile differs by event. The course map and elevation profile are on the event's course page and in the athlete guide.
paraphrases: How many hills are there on the bike course?

qa.question: What is the weather like on race day?

paraphrases: What is the usual weather on race day?

qa.question: What should I eat the night before the race?
qa.answer: Eat familiar, easily digested, carbohydrate-rich food, and avoid trying anything new. Stay hydrated and keep your usual routine.
paraphrases: What should I have for dinner before the race?

qa.question: Can spectators enter the finish area?
qa.answer: Spectators can watch from the public areas around the finish line. Access to the finish chute and athlete recovery area is restricted to athletes and officials.

qa.question: How do I get to Kona from the airport?
qa.answer: Fly into Kona International Airport (KOA) at Keahole. From there you can use a rental car, taxi or shuttle to reach Kailua-Kona.
paraphrases: How can I travel from the airport to Kona?

qa.question: Is a helmet required on the bike?

qa.question: Is there a maximum age limit for IRONMAN races?

paraphrases: Is there an upper age limit for IRONMAN races?

qa.question: Do all finishers get a medal?
